# hpe_morpheus_power_schedule (Resource)

Manages a Morpheus Power Schedule resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hpe_morpheus_power_schedule" "example" {
  name = "Example Power Schedule"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the power schedule.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the power schedule.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the power schedule is enabled.
- `friday_off_time` (String) The Friday off time for the power schedule.
- `friday_on_time` (String) The Friday on time for the power schedule.
- `monday_off_time` (String) The Monday off time for the power schedule.
- `monday_on_time` (String) The Monday on time for the power schedule.
- `saturday_off_time` (String) The Saturday off time for the power schedule.
- `saturday_on_time` (String) The Saturday on time for the power schedule.
- `schedule_timezone` (String) The timezone of the power schedule.
- `schedule_type` (String) The schedule type of the power schedule.
- `sunday_off_time` (String) The Sunday off time for the power schedule.
- `sunday_on_time` (String) The Sunday on time for the power schedule.
- `thursday_off_time` (String) The Thursday off time for the power schedule.
- `thursday_on_time` (String) The Thursday on time for the power schedule.
- `tuesday_off_time` (String) The Tuesday off time for the power schedule.
- `tuesday_on_time` (String) The Tuesday on time for the power schedule.
- `wednesday_off_time` (String) The Wednesday off time for the power schedule.
- `wednesday_on_time` (String) The Wednesday on time for the power schedule.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the power schedule.
- `total_monthly_hours_saved` (Number) The total monthly hours saved by the power schedule.

## Import

Import is supported using the resource ID.

```bash
terraform import hpe_morpheus_power_schedule.example 123
```
